purpose: Keep Orchid Continuum in healthy dynamic equilibrium by converting observed drift into bounded corrective intents.

organism_model.genome: GitHub code, schemas, migrations, tests and governed instructions
organism_model.living_memory: Neon/PostgreSQL scientific state, provenance, queues, observations and durable state
organism_model.metabolism: Render workers, schedulers, leases, queues, compute and provider budgets
organism_model.membrane: Federation adapters, authentication, provenance/licensing checks, caches, rate limits and provider gates
organism_model.nervous_system: Brain/Calyx sensing, reasoning, planning and prioritization
organism_model.circulation: shared queues, completion receipts, evidence ledgers and module handoffs
organism_model.immune_system: validation, anomaly detection, quarantine, security and provenance enforcement

idle_definition: No corrective intervention is required and monitored vital signs are within policy; idle never means unobserved.
